The eventful summer training camp has 
finally come to an end—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I just can't get used to this. Just like 
last year, it's so hard to say goodbye.

text_block_list.text: Ah, looks like the bus is here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head back to the academy, 
Trainer?

Summer training camp has ended, and the 
Mainichi Okan is right around the corner—
